request: Build a small Jac web app for a developer community. A developer has a profile with a name, a status and a list of skills. Developers write posts, other developers can like a post once and add comments to it. The posts page lists posts newest first with their like and comment counts. Keep the forum rules in a reusable service.
acceptance: A developer can like a given post at most once; a second like is rejected.
Comments are stored on their post and counted on the posts page.
A profile lists its skills in the order given.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements paraphrased in English from the repository README/description; no code copied.
